title: Clarify taxonomy contribution process
author: julianna-ciq

inline_text: Updates CONTRIBUTING.md for accuracy and establishes a clearer end-to-end taxonomy contribution process. Documents how Working Groups propose terms, how delegates bring terms to the Taxonomy Workstream, the KEEP/CULL/DEBATE review outcomes, definition and scope-note expectations, cross-Working-Group approval requirements, the Rebase and merge strategy, and the FINALIZED spreadsheet state. Also standardizes terminology, Markdown formatting, schema references, and section numbering.
